description: This file contains pure game logic helpers for Tic Tac Toe, designed to be UI-agnostic for ease of testing and reuse. It defines game constants, winning line configurations, and functions to determine game state such as winning lines and draws.

methods.name: winningLine
methods.description: Returns the winning line indices if there is a winner, otherwise null.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Returns true if the game is a draw (all cells filled with no winner).
